download_file_with_progress: download a file from a URL to a local path with a tqdm progress bar
extract_tar_with_progress: extract a tar archive to a directory with a tqdm progress bar
ensure_dir_create: ensure a directory exists by creating it and all parent directories if needed
download_and_extract_tar: download a tar file from a URL then extract it to a target directory
refactor_download_file: refactor the download_file function to support resumable downloads or authentication headers
